name: AFTP Multiplayer Balance (多人心愿单平衡)
author: Twelve-eight
description: Multiplayer balance adjustments for Acts from the Past (hard dependency; the mod does not load without it). After the original AFTP lifecycle runs, it replaces Transient's Shifting power with the multiplayer-threshold variant, Awakened One's Curiosity and Gremlin Nob/Gremlin Mad's Enrage/Angry powers with the multiplayer variants, and relabels Shifting Strength. Ships a default-on master switch plus one switch per behavior group (BaseLib settings page, mod_configs/ActsFromThePastMultiplayerBalance.cfg): master off registers no Harmony patches at all, a group off restores that group's original AFTP behavior, and switch changes apply on the next game start.
